---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new model, metric, or capability for the framework
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise
description of what the problem is (e.g. "There's no way to benchmark
gradient boosting from LightGBM alongside the existing models").

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

- [ ] New model (specify which, and link to its scikit-learn-compatible API)
- [ ] New feature engineering technique
- [ ] New feature selection method
- [ ] New evaluation metric
- [ ] New visualization
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features
you've considered.

## Implementation Notes

If you have thoughts on how this fits the existing architecture (see
[`docs/architecture.md`](../../docs/architecture.md)), share them here —
e.g. which file(s) would need to change, whether it requires a new
config schema, etc.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, links to papers/documentation, or screenshots
about the feature request here.
